study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter prospective study
outcome: Failure of placental separation at delivery
Prenatal ultrasound diagnostic accuracy for PAS
cohort: Patients aged >=18 years with posterior low-lying placenta or placenta previa, undergoing ultrasound assessment at >=26+0 weeks of gestation.
finding: Prior uterine surgery is the most common risk factor for posterior Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) in patients with placenta previa or low-lying placenta, and posterior PAS is associated with a lower risk of hysterectomy compared to anterior PAS.
